title.zh: 盈科披露币印破产案最新进展：资产出售获批，债权申报截止日临近
title.en: 盈科披露币印破产案最新进展：资产出售获批，债权申报截止日临近

current_state.zh: A US bankruptcy court approved the sale of a Poolin-affiliated debtor's Texas mining-farm assets for up to roughly $180M, moving the case into claim confirmation and distribution, with a proposed general creditor bar date of Dec 31, 2026 and a Nov 10 hearing.
